{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Drop rows with sentinel values in biomarker_baseline (missing data)
trial_clean = trial_df[trial_df['biomarker_baseline'] != -999.0]

# Compute response rates within each arm, by sex
response_by_arm_sex = trial_clean.groupby(['arm', 'sex'])['responded'].mean().unstack(fill_value=0)

# Compute the difference in response rates within each arm
response_diff_within_arm = response_by_arm_sex['F'] - response_by_arm_sex['M']

# Compute the overall response rate by arm
response_by_arm = trial_clean.groupby('arm')['responded'].mean()

# Check the distribution of severity and site within each arm and sex
severity_by_arm_sex = pd.crosstab(trial_clean['arm'], [trial_clean['sex'], trial_clean['severity']], margins=True)
site_by_arm_sex = pd.crosstab(trial_clean['arm'], [trial_clean['sex'], trial_clean['site']], margins=True)

# Compute the difference in response rates within each arm
response_diff_within_arm, response_by_arm, severity_by_arm_sex, site_by_arm_sex"}
